candidates_reviewed.name: Source-aware verification for tool-using agents
candidates_reviewed.mechanism_comparison: The reviewed Ai2 development adds current primary evidence to the same tracked mechanism: AstaBrief 8B is open-sourced for cited scientific report generation with citation-focused filtering and explicit emphasis on preserving what evidence actually supports.
candidates_reviewed.mechanism: Keep each claim tied to the specific tool output or record that supports it instead of pooling all retrieved evidence.
candidates_reviewed.rationale: A current primary source adds a distinct development to the existing Source-aware verification for tool-using agents mechanism.
candidates_reviewed.limitations: The evidence is focused on scientific report generation; transfer to general-purpose tool-using agents and independent evaluation remain open questions.

candidates_reviewed.name: Agents that persist across sessions
candidates_reviewed.mechanism_comparison: The reviewed AWS development adds current primary evidence to the same tracked mechanism: Bedrock AgentCore demonstrates event-driven ambient agents where the event itself triggers work and human approval gates consequential next steps.
candidates_reviewed.mechanism: Design agents around goals that continue over time instead of treating every interaction as a one-shot task.
candidates_reviewed.rationale: A current primary source adds a distinct development to the existing Agents that persist across sessions mechanism.
candidates_reviewed.limitations: The source is a first-party implementation pattern; independent reliability, cost and failure-recovery evidence across deployments remains limited.

candidates_reviewed.name: AI harness engineering becomes a first-class layer
candidates_reviewed.mechanism_comparison: The reviewed GitHub development adds current primary evidence to the same tracked mechanism: Copilot code review is callable through REST and GraphQL APIs with per-request effort controls, making AI review a programmable workflow component.
candidates_reviewed.mechanism: Treat the harness around a model—repository structure, tools, constraints, state, validation, and control loops—as an engineering system in its own right.
candidates_reviewed.rationale: A current primary source adds a distinct development to the existing AI harness engineering becomes a first-class layer mechanism.
candidates_reviewed.limitations: API availability does not by itself prove review quality, low false-positive rates or safe autonomous merge decisions.
